testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/shopping-cart/verify-request-quote-access-for-guest-and-retail.spec.ts > Webstore - Shopping Cart > verify request quote access for guest and retail

scenario.summary: A guest adds one simple product and checks that the cart has no Request Quote button. The registered user then signs in, opens the merged cart and checks that Request Quote is visible on a store with quote requests from the webstore enabled. The cart is emptied and the user logs out. No quote or order is created.
steps: Guest (empty storage state): add sku with quantity 1 and open the cart
Check the Request Quote button is absent (count 0)
Sign in with username/password and open the cart (guest cart merges into the account)
Check the Request Quote button is visible
Remove all items and check the empty cart message
Log out and check the sign-in link
stateChanges: Guest cart: product added; merged into the registered user's cart on sign-in; all items removed at the end
No quote or order is created
assertions: Guest: Request Quote button count is 0
Signed in: Request Quote button is visible
evidence: Title: 'verify request quote access for guest and retail'
Profile: sku z-240008 is an active published SimpleProduct 'RegUi_SimpleProd', inventory 999

The signed-in assertion needs the store's 'Enable Quote Requests From Web Store' = Yes: STORE_WEBSTORE_QUOTE_REQUESTS_ENABLED (store MaxwellsHardware), used instead of STORE_WEBSTORE_ACTIVE (it includes the active-webstore condition; declaring both could demand two different stores)
Not covered by any key: whether the user's role or profile further restricts quotes (KB Quote Settings are per store); confirm on atstage
Literal '0' at spec line 40 is the toHaveCount expectation (config)

sources.value: Hi! Your shopping cart is empty.
